verdict.rationale: Navan's in-product AI assistant Ava is described as analyzing travel spend and crafting savings suggestions. It also summarizes spend by month and category, compares spend to policy, predicts future spend, and proactively finds savings opportunities. That covers insights and suggestions generated from the user's own data, and the 'price to beat' smart target adds data-driven guidance at booking time. The MCP server serves the same analysis to external AI tools, but that is outside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Ava beyond a launch blog post, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
